Claim Gate for Panel-Null Benchmarks

Source: R/panel-gates.R
os_claim_gate.Rd

Applies a fail-closed panel-claim policy: if the disease contrast has not passed the provenance/identifiability review, no method can receive a positive primary label. If identifiability passed, p-values are Holm adjusted and a method passes only when adjusted p-value, null95 margin, and null QC all satisfy the prespecified thresholds.

Usage

os_claim_gate(
  results,
  identifiability_status,
  required_margin = 0.02,
  alpha = 0.05
)

Arguments

results

Data frame with columns method_id, p_value, observed_stat, null_p95, and null_qc_pass.

identifiability_status

One of "PASS", "FAIL", or "INCONCLUSIVE".

required_margin

Numeric margin required over null95.

alpha

Family-wise alpha for Holm-adjusted p-values.

Value

Data frame with adjusted p-values, margins, and labels.
